body: Standardized Distributed Generative and Predictive AI Inference Platform for Scalable, Multi-Framework Deployment on Kubernetes
plain_description: **Deploy AI models on Kubernetes through one platform for generative and predictive inference.** Supports multiple model frameworks and can scale workloads based on demand. Offers model caching and GPU acceleration for generative AI.
technical_description: KServe is a distributed AI inference platform for deploying generative and predictive models on Kubernetes. It supports vLLM and llm-d for LLM serving, OpenAI-compatible inference, and predictive frameworks including TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost, and ONNX. Features include request-based autoscaling, model caching, traffic routing, canary rollouts, inference pipelines, and model explanations.
title: KServe
